descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At Garmin we create products that are designed indoors for outdoor activities. We do this to enable our customers to make the most of their time spent pursuing their passions.
We recognize the value of flexibility in supporting employee well-being, work-life balance, and effective collaboration. Associates may work from home up to four days per month, or one day per week, while remaining connected to the teams and culture that help us do our best work.
We are a global company with offices in the US, Europe and Asia. In these centers, we carry out the various stages of product development, from initial concept to mass production of ready-to-sell units. We embrace a vertically integrated business model with strategic design, manufacturing, distribution, sales and support centers around the world to maximize our value to customers.
The ERP Team connects Oracle ERP with warehouse automation technologies, transforming enterprise transactions into automated warehouse actions. Through seamless integration with automation platforms, we enable faster, more accurate, and more efficient warehouse operations.
Our mission is to provide robust, reliable, and scalable integrations between our ERP systems and warehouse automation solutions, ensuring smooth and efficient business processes across the supply chain.
With impactful projects come significant responsibilities. The solutions we build play a critical role in both customer satisfaction and business success. As a Software Quality Engineer, you will contribute to this mission by designing, developing, and executing automated tests that help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our integrations. Your work will directly support our commitment to delivering exceptional value to our stakeholders.
 Responsibilities: 
Testing newly developed software, features, and recording any issues/improvements 
Developing and running effective tests to ensure product's stability and performance 
Providing information to development teams to support their bug fixing 
Create documentation and select appropriate testing techniques and methods necessary for product validation, according to requirements
 Requirements
Must demonstrate experience in writing automated tests and manual testing 
Good grasp of OOP principles (preferably Java and SQL, but any other OOP language will do) 
Can document, troubleshoot and isolate problems encountered during testing 
At least 2 years of experience in working with ERP Systems (Oracle EBS, SAP, etc.) and web applications 
BSc in Computer Science or demonstrated relevant experience 
Familiarity working in an Agile environment 
Has strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills 
 Technologies used for testing:
Postman, Playwright with Java, SQL or similar tools 
REST test framework 
Database servers (ability to find deadlocks, simple queries), troubleshooting logs 
BrowserStack 
 Would be a plus:
ISTQB Foundation or equivalent 
Experience with Continuous Integration (Jenkins, TeamCity) 
 Benefits
 Benefits to enhance your experience:
24 days off each year plus extra vacation days based on years at Garmin and compensation for legal holidays
Health package subscription and yearly budget for glasses
Monthly budget for sports and wellbeing activities
Local and global career development programs (training, mentorship, technical and leadership development, and more)
Access to e-learning platforms and support for technical conferences attendance
Loyalty bonus within the company, plus other special bonuses (for holidays and personal life events)
Meal tickets
 Yours exclusively when part of our team:
Significant discount for Garmin products
Employee stock purchase plan
Contribution to the retirement plan (Pillar 3)
Garmin products available for testing and borrowing
A comprehensive event series championing wellbeing, sports, and community tailored to foster holistic health (featuring sports events, classes, hackathons, parties, and more)
Other benefits which we invite you to discover along the recruitment process
 Garmin Cluj is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, age or disability.
